description: Imitation loops (lab/learn/imitate.py, 5 Nov morning, one core each): agreement with the legend's human RiftLite moves, held-out by game (leave-one-game-out) and on the games learned, then play tests of the Riven nets (Riven best list) against the Kennen and Evelynn specialists, 100 games each, seats swapped, sims 50. Caveat: the start nets had seen part of these human games in training, so their held-out agreement is optimistic; the imitation nets were trained with an old, small self-play file as value anchor (data/learn/iter_039.rbvd), which may have hurt their value head.
conclusion: Imitating the human games through (97% of their moves) generalises no better than 4-8 epochs and plays far worse; imitation alone with 8-30 games per legend does not make a stronger bot. It stays a mild term inside the specialists' training, its weight evolved by the population (spec_human_weight).
